description: This file contains unit tests for voice wake helper functions related to trigger sanitization, locale normalization, and related behaviors within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: VoiceWakeHelpersTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test functions for voice wake helpers.

methods.name: sanitize triggers trims and drops empty
methods.description: Test that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers removes whitespace-only strings and trims input triggers.

methods.name: sanitize triggers falls back to defaults
methods.description: Test that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers returns default triggers when input is empty or whitespace-only.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word length
methods.description: Test that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers enforces a maximum word length constraint.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word count
methods.description: Test that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers enforces a maximum number of trigger words.

methods.name: normalize locale strips collation
methods.description: Test that normalizeLocaleIdentifier removes collation extensions from locale identifiers.

methods.name: normalize locale strips unicode extensions
methods.description: Test that normalizeLocaleIdentifier removes Unicode extensions from locale identifiers.
